attr.title: Crossy Road
attr.desc: Testing candidate 0.2.0-rc1: Android Crossy Road 4.5.0, native SDL controller integration, offline local saves and haptics. Verified device scope: RG35XX-H/KNULLI; other CFWs need testing.
attr.inst: Copy your exact crossy-road-4-5-0.apk to ports/crossyroad and launch Crossy Road. The launcher automatically verifies and prepares the APK, then starts the game; no second script or handheld compiler is required. SHA-256: 1ad8bed1353b36a953c020c1562a519adceda02e4b4e98afa8eaf0db87643afb. Required game file SHA-256: 1ad8bed1353b36a953c020c1562a519adceda02e4b4e98afa8eaf0db87643afb.
attr.inst_md:
**Required game file:** `crossy-road-4-5-0.apk`

**SHA-256:**
```text
1ad8bed1353b36a953c020c1562a519adceda02e4b4e98afa8eaf0db87643afb
```

1. Download [crossyroad.zip](https://github.com/elarkitechto/rg35xxh-ports/releases/latest/download/crossyroad.zip) and extract it into **Ports**.
2. Copy `crossy-road-4-5-0.apk` into `ports/crossyroad/`.
3. Launch **Crossy Road** from Ports. First-run setup is automatic.

Keep the APK in that folder. When updating, replace the package files and keep your saves.
